caseName: Virginia Electric & Power Co. v. Johnson
caseNameFull: VIRGINIA ELECTRIC & POWER CO. v. JOHNSON, COMMISSIONER OF REVENUE OF NORTH CAROLINA
attorneys: George D. Gibson and John W. Riely for appellant., Thomas Wade Bruton, Attorney General of North Carolina, and Peyton B. Abbott, Lucius W. Pullen and Thomas L. Young, Assistant Attorneys General, for respondent.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
